# Devariam

> Devariam is the professional portfolio of Abderrahmane Charak, a state-certified software engineer and product designer based in Marrakech, Morocco. He is available for remote freelance projects.

## Professional profile

Abderrahmane Charak builds web and mobile products and works across web interfaces, backend APIs, product design, and applied AI/NLP. His documented education is a Software Engineering State Engineer Degree from EMSI. The main portfolio interface has English, French, and Spanish translations; the services page is also available in English, French, Spanish, and Arabic. Abderrahmane speaks Arabic, English, and French.

## Services and capabilities

- Web platforms and interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Backend development and REST APIs with Django, Flask, and Node.js.
- Product design and UX systems using Figma.
- Applied AI and natural language processing using Python, TensorFlow, and NLTK.
